name: Keffiyeh
description: A large square of heavy white cotton woven with a black net pattern and edged with a knotted fringe. Wrapped round the head and across the face, it keeps off sun, wind and dust.
notes: Folded square, 260 mm across, 296 mm deep with its fringe and 36 mm tall: five folds of `cloth-cream`, a raised `cloth-black` net and border on top and a fringe of alternating black and cream along +z. Slot `hood`, as headscarves and the grass keffiyeh take; it also covers the face when wrapped, which one slot cannot express. CHECK VOLUME (x4.9): the folded stack's box against the reference's packed bulk; a 425 g cloth square folds no smaller than this. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
